extensionAttribute.description: Minutes of idle time before the computer enters sleep on the active power profile.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Computer Sleep Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # pmset -g custom is the documented way to read the active profile's # sleep timer. The legacy "pmset -g" approach matched the wrong column # when "displaysleep" appeared first.
value=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g custom 2>/dev/null \ | /usr/bin/awk '/^[[:space:]]*sleep[[:space:]]/ { print $2; exit }')
echo "<result>${value:-Unknown}</result>"
